_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-23 slate (Taipei 09-24). Twenty-third slate of the prospective test. Thirteen of the sixteen games on the US card; Blue Jays at Orioles G2, Guardians at Red Sox and Marlins at Cubs are on the card but not this board. Blue Jays at Orioles G1 is the makeup of the game postponed on 09-22, keyed G1 because the pairing is a doubleheader today. No reading conflict: all thirteen favourites agree with the US moneyline, and the board's own moneyline column, shown in nine, agrees in all nine. Of the four without it, Orioles G1 (0.5358), Pirates (0.5227) and White Sox (0.5154 away) match my reading on the market alone, and Mets at Rangers is a 0 handicap on a dead 0.5000 market. A correction to the 09-22 settlement: I wrote there that the makeup would have different starters from the postponed game. This board lists G1 with the same pair, Scherzer against Bassitt, so that claim was wrong. The decision it was offered in support of stands on its own grounds -- the 09-22 ticket is void under the book's cancelled-game rule, and today's G1 is a separately hung line on a separate board, priced here on its own -- but the stated reason was not true and is withdrawn. Handicaps flat at 0.950, totals flat at 0.940, no split prices.
